en.autopilotTitle: It follows through, and more. Set it once in plain words.

en.ap1Q: Is anything going to deliver late this week?
en.ap1A: Just one. MS482611 moved from Tue to Wed — everything else is on time.
en.ap1Note: Know about trouble before it costs you. Ask about late shipments any time, so your customers hear it from you first.
en.ap1More1Q: Which shipments are past their pickup date?
en.ap1More1A: None right now. All 8 of this week’s pickups happened on schedule.

en.ap2Note: Paperwork in seconds. Ask for any BOL or signed delivery receipt by shipment, so proof of delivery is never a search.

en.ap2More2Q: Which of this week’s deliveries have a signed POD?

en.ap3Q: Post pickup and delivery updates to our TMS.
en.ap3A: Done. Every status change, pickup to delivery, now posts to your TMS.
en.ap3Note: Know the moment freight moves. Set up a webhook once, and every pickup and delivery posts straight to your own systems.
en.ap3More1Q: Which webhooks do we have set up?
en.ap3More1A: One, sending shipment status updates to tms.acme.com/hooks. It’s active.
en.ap3More2Q: Send new bookings to that webhook too.
en.ap3More2A: Done. It now gets new bookings as well as status updates.
